GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2021-02-18T07:23:22Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Router only response first route if using dependency injection on router
Description: This is related to #4528 

Full codes are as per following:

<details>
<summary>/index.js</summary>

```js
const express = require('express');
const app = express();

app.use('/buy',require('./routes/buy'))
app.use('/sell',require('./routes/sell'))

app.listen(5000,()=>{
  console.log('Server start')
})
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>/routes/buy.js</summary>

```js
const express = require('express')
const router = express.Router()
const buyController = require('../controller/buy.js')

router.use('/:id/log', require('./log')(router, 'BuyModel'))
router.route('/').get(buyController.fetchBuys)

module.exports = router
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>/routes/sell.js</summary>

```js
const express = require('express')
const router = express.Router()

router.use('/:id/log', require('./log')(router, 'SaleModel'))

module.exports = router
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>/routes/log.js</summary>

```js
const logController = require('../controller/log')

module.exports = function(router, model){
  router.route('/')
    .get(logController.fetchLogs(model))
  return router
}
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>/controller/log.js</summary>

```js
exports.fetchLogs = model => (req, res, next) => {
  console.log('fetch logs');
  console.log('base_url:', req.baseUrl);
  console.log('...');

  return res.status(200).send('done')
}
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>/controller/buy.js</summary>

```js
exports.fetchBuys = (req, res, next) => {
  console.log('base_url:', req.baseUrl);
  console.log('result: fetch buys');
  console.log('...')
  res.status(200).send()
}

```
</details>

---

Current code consoles:

**GET: /buy**
fetch logs
base_url: /buy

**GET: /buy/123/log**
fetch logs
base_url: /buy/123/log

---

What I hope is:

**GET: /buy**
fetch buys
base_url: /buy

**GET: /buy/123/log**
fetch logs
base_url: /buy/123/log

---

If I reverse the route sequence in /routes/buy.js like following

```js
router.route('/').get(buyController.fetchBuys)
router.use('/:id/log', require('./log')(router, 'BuyModel'))
```

**GET: /buy**
fetch buys
base_url: /buy

**GET: /buy/123/log**
fetch buys
base_url: /buy/123/log

---

Would like to know how can I make it work if I still want to use dependency injection in router
